title: Resolution-normalized shifts of the basic system operations
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$, $n\ge1$. On the small pro-etale sites of finite-type $k$-schemes $W$ put $\widehat R_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$. Let $\mathscr S_W$ be strict quotient-semilinear systems of $(A_n)_W$-module sheaves, with ordinary unbounded derived categories, reduction $\mathcal R_W$ and total limit $\mathcal L_W=R\lim\operatorname{Res}$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Use the simultaneous ringed-diagram models, exact inverse image $P_v$ for separated finite-type $v$, total derived direct image $S_p$ for proper $p$, exact extension by zero $J_j$ for quasi-compact open $j$, and derived system tensor [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization]. Use the cochain convention $C[r]^i=C^{i+r}$, $d_{C[r]}=(-1)^rd_C$, and the prescribed comparisons [def-pur-integral-operation-shift-data].

The comparisons obtained from simultaneous resolutions for $P_v,S_p,J_j$ and either individual tensor slot are natural isomorphisms of derived systems, independent of representatives and coherent for zero and addition of integer shifts. On exact inverse image and open extension the comparison is identity on the reindexed terms. For a K-injective resolution $M\to I$, the comparison for $S_p(M[r])$ is computed by $M[r]\to I[r]$ and the degreewise equality $p_*(I[r])=(p_*I)[r]$; this is the right-adjoint mate of the inverse-image shift, with its actual unit and counit. On flat-term K-flat tensor representatives the comparison $t_{a,b}:M[a]\otimes^LN[b]\cong(M\otimes^LN)[a+b]$ has coefficient $(-1)^{bi}$ on $M[a]^i\otimes N[b]^j$. Thus a first-slot shift has coefficient $1$ and a second-slot shift $r$ has coefficient $(-1)^{ri}$. These comparisons commute with strict quotient transitions, are chain isomorphisms for the total differential, and respect the canonical associator and Koszul symmetry of tensor. The same finite-level formulas represent the prescribed completed integral tensor comparisons, followed by the product and shifted-cone normalization; in the second slot this is exactly [lem-sf-completed-tensor-shift-right].

proof.text: For each exact ordinary inverse image and open extension, apply the identity degree-component lemma for mapHomologicalComplex and the CommShift instance of mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom. Expanding the composite shift formula gives exactly BasicExactShiftModels for the prescribed shift. No choice or existence of resolutions is needed.

For the supplied direct-image model, transpose the ordinary counit using its recorded transpose equation. The ordinary triangle identity shows that the derived-unit natural transformation is the mate of the exact localization factorization under the actual derived adjunction. The right shift is defined as the mate shift, so the derived adjunction unit/counit commute with shifts by Mathlib commShift_of_leftAdjoint. The cochain adjunction unit is termwise compatible with shifts; its counit is compatible by the triangle identities. Whiskering the counit, exact factorization and derived adjunction unit proves CommShift for the actual directUnit. Shift the supplied K-injective resolution (no new resolution is chosen). Multiply directUnit.shift_app_comm by its inverse components at I and I[r], and use naturality of the localization and direct-image shifts along a. The result is exactly the required BasicSystemImageShiftModels square. The adjunction CommShift just used is BasicSystemImageMate.

Apply lem-pur-system-tensor-shift-representative-models to obtain the simultaneous chain generator formula and the exact derived comparison square for tensor_models. Apply lem-pur-system-tensor-prescribed-shift-coherence and project its three factors to get system_tensor_laws, tensor_associativity and tensor_symmetry. These are proper subarguments on a single arbitrary scheme, independent of the operation package and geometric arrows.

The four one-slot model properties are exactly the four normalized fields of the prescribed TensorShifts package: project systemLeft_normalized, systemRight_normalized, integralLeft_normalized and integralRight_normalized. Apply lem-pur-completed-tensor-prescribed-slot-shift-laws for integral_tensor_laws. Introduce the stated finite-type, separated/proper/open geometric hypotheses and assemble all thirteen fields; the lemmas apply for arbitrary schemes and arbitrary supplied direct-image models.
